description: This file defines the BindingsController class responsible for managing JavaScript bindings in a browser automation context, including adding, removing, and handling binding callbacks.

classes.name: BindingsController
classes.description: Manages JavaScript bindings, including adding, removing, and delivering results for bindings in a browser automation environment.

methods.name: addBinding
methods.description: Adds a new binding with specified name and handle requirements.

methods.name: removeBinding
methods.description: Removes an existing binding by name.

methods.name: takeBindingHandle
methods.description: Retrieves and deletes a handle associated with a binding call.

methods.name: deliverBindingResult
methods.description: Delivers the result or error of a binding call to the waiting promise.
